acid-arrow.note: On a hit it takes 2d4 acid again at the end of its next turn (also +1d4 per slot level above 2nd); on a miss it takes half the initial damage only.

acid-splash.note: Can target two creatures within 5 feet of each other.

aid.note: Up to three targets; each one's hit point maximum and current hit points rise by 5 for 8 hours, plus 5 per slot level above 2nd.

alter-self.note: Natural Weapons option: your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage with a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls.

animal-friendship.note: Only a beast with Intelligence 3 or lower; ends if you or your companions harm it.

bane.note: Up to three targets subtract a d4 from attack rolls and saving throws; one more target per slot level above 1st.

bestow-curse.note: Cursed for the duration with one option: disadvantage on one ability's checks and saves, disadvantage on attacks against you, a Wis save each turn or lose its action, or an extra 1d8 necrotic from your attacks and spells.

bless.note: Up to three targets; one more per slot level above 1st.

blindness-deafness.note: Blinded or deafened (your choice); it saves again at the end of each of its turns; one more target per slot level above 2nd.

blink.note: Roll a d20 at the end of each of your turns; on 11 or higher you vanish to the Ethereal Plane until the start of your next turn.

branding-smite.note: Only your next weapon hit; the target becomes visible, sheds dim light and can't turn invisible until the spell ends.

call-lightning.note: You can call another bolt as your action on each of your turns; outdoors in a storm the damage increases by 1d10.

calm-emotions.note: Humanoids only; on a failed save you suppress charmed or frightened effects on it, or make it indifferent to creatures it is hostile toward.

charm-person.note: Advantage on the save if you or your companions are fighting it; ends if you harm it; one more target per slot level above 1st.

chill-touch.note: Can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn; an undead target also has disadvantage on attacks against you.

color-spray.note: Roll 6d10 (plus 2d10 per slot level above 1st) for the hit points of creatures blinded, lowest current hit points first.

command.note: The target follows a one-word command on its next turn (Grovel: it falls prone); one more target per slot level above 1st.

detect-thoughts.note: Only when you probe deeper: on a failed save you learn its reasoning and emotional state; on a success the spell ends.

divine-favor.note: On every weapon hit until the spell ends.

enhance-ability.note: Temporary hit points only with Bear's Endurance; every option gives advantage on one ability's checks; one more target per slot level above 2nd.

enlarge-reduce.note: Only an unwilling target saves; enlarged it has advantage on Strength checks and saves and its weapons deal 1d4 extra, reduced the reverse and 1d4 less.

entangle.note: A restrained creature can use its action for a Strength check against your spell save DC to free itself.

enthrall.note: On a failed save it has disadvantage on Perception checks to notice anyone but you; advantage on the save if you're fighting it.

faerie-fire.note: Attack rolls against an outlined creature have advantage, and it can't benefit from being invisible.

fear.note: It drops what it holds and must Dash away from you; it saves again when it ends a turn out of your line of sight.

flame-blade.note: Each attack with the blade takes your action while the spell lasts.

flaming-sphere.note: A creature saves when it ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere or when you ram the sphere into it as a bonus action.

glyph-of-warding.note: Explosive runes only, when the glyph is triggered; a spell glyph casts the stored spell instead.

goodberry.note: Makes up to ten berries; a creature that eats one as an action regains 1 hit point.

grease.note: A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there saves again or falls prone.

guiding-bolt.note: The next attack roll against the target before the end of your next turn has advantage.

gust-of-wind.area: line 60 feet long and 10 feet wide
gust-of-wind.note: A creature that starts its turn in the line saves or is pushed 15 feet away; moving toward you costs double.

heat-metal.note: Hits any creature touching the object, again as a bonus action each turn; a holder makes a Con save or drops it, else has disadvantage on attacks and checks.

heroism.note: Gains these temporary hit points again at the start of each of its turns and is immune to being frightened.

hideous-laughter.note: Saves again at the end of each of its turns and when it takes damage (with advantage); no effect on Intelligence 4 or less.

hold-person.note: Humanoids only; it saves again at the end of each of its turns; one more humanoid per slot level above 2nd.

hunters-mark.note: Only on your weapon hits against the marked target; the mark can move to a new target when it drops to 0 hit points.

hypnotic-pattern.note: Only creatures that see the pattern; speed 0 while charmed; ends for a creature that takes damage or is shaken out of it.

invisibility.note: Ends for a target that attacks or casts a spell; one more target per slot level above 2nd.

levitate.note: Only an unwilling creature saves; on a failure it rises up to 20 feet and hangs there for the duration.

lightning-bolt.area: line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide

magic-circle.note: Only a creature of a chosen type that tries to teleport in saves; such creatures have disadvantage on attacks against those inside and can't charm, frighten or possess them.

mass-healing-word.note: Up to six creatures; no effect on undead or constructs.

meld-into-stone.note: If the stone is partly destroyed or reshaped you are expelled, take 6d6 bludgeoning and fall prone (50 bludgeoning if it is destroyed).

mirror-image.note: When a creature attacks you, roll a d20 (6+ with three duplicates, 8+ with two, 11+ with one) to hit a duplicate instead; a duplicate has AC 10 + your Dex modifier.

moonbeam.note: A creature saves when it enters the beam for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there; shapechangers save with disadvantage.

prayer-of-healing.note: Up to six creatures; no effect on undead or constructs.

ray-of-enfeeblement.note: On a hit its Strength weapon attacks deal half damage; it makes a Con save at the end of each of its turns to end the spell.

ray-of-frost.note: Its speed drops by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

resistance.note: Once before the spell ends, the target adds a d4 to one saving throw.

revivify.note: Only a creature that died within the last minute; it returns to life with 1 hit point.

sacred-flame.note: The target gets no benefit from cover for this save.

shatter.note: Creatures made of inorganic material have disadvantage on the save.

shocking-grasp.note: Advantage against a target in metal armor; on a hit it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

silence.note: Only while entirely inside; creatures there are immune to thunder damage and can't cast spells with a verbal component.

sleep.note: Roll 5d8 (plus 2d8 per slot level above 1st) for the hit points of creatures put to sleep, lowest first; undead and charm-immune creatures are unaffected; damage or a shake wakes a sleeper.

sleet-storm.note: Saves when it enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there; a concentrating creature there makes a Con save or loses concentration.

slow.note: Up to six targets: half speed, -2 AC and Dex saves, no reactions, action or bonus action, one attack, d20 11+ delays its spells; saves again at the end of each turn.

spike-growth.note: For every 5 feet a creature moves into or within the area, which is difficult terrain.

spirit-guardians.note: A creature saves when it enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there; its speed is halved there; necrotic only if you are evil.

spiritual-weapon.note: You can move the weapon and attack again as a bonus action on each of your turns for 1 minute.

stinking-cloud.note: Each creature completely in the cloud at the start of its turn saves or spends its action retching; creatures that don't breathe or are immune to poison succeed.

suggestion.note: On a failed save it follows a reasonable suggested course of action; ends if you or your companions damage it; charm-immune creatures are unaffected.

thunderwave.note: On a failed save the creature is also pushed 10 feet away.

vampiric-touch.note: You regain hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt; you can attack again as an action each turn for 1 minute.

vicious-mockery.note: On a failed save it also has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

web.note: Saves when it starts its turn in or enters the webs; a Strength check against your DC frees it; burning webs deal 2d4 fire to creatures starting their turn in the fire.

wind-wall.area: wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high and 1 foot thick
wind-wall.note: Only creatures in the wall when it appears; it blocks Small or smaller fliers, gases and ordinary arrows and bolts.

zone-of-truth.note: Saves when it enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there; on a failure it can't speak a deliberate lie.
